title.narrative: Appraisal of Unlocking Sustainable Investments at Scale towards Adaptation

description.narrative: The objective of the assignment is to support MFA (LÆRING) in drafting an independent appraisal of the Programme Document. The appraisal is to assess the relevance, quality and feasibility of the programme design and documentation and if it is fit to underpin programme implementation and produce the expected results in an effective, efficient and sustainable manner in compliance with the OECD-DAC criteria and principles and rules of Danida policies and Aid Management Guidelines, including the fundamental principles of Doing Development Differently. The appraisal will provide specific recommendations for adjustments or improvements to the abovementioned document.
